summary: Tested the public ProMão preview across backend APIs and responsive UI. Core registration, login, session restoration, logout, protected request creation, services/providers, Google prepared messaging, navigation, and mobile layout passed.

critical.issue: Public gateway returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials on OPTIONS, despite backend configuring explicit FRONTEND_URL and credentials. Cross-origin credentialed preflight can fail.

integration_issues.issue: The search input is not read; clicking the search arrow always calls search(""), so typed service/professional queries do not filter results.
The ‘Criar agora/Entrar’ switch only closes the modal instead of changing between register and login modes.

action_items: Fix gateway/ingress OPTIONS CORS handling so explicit origin and allow-credentials are preserved.
Wire service-search input value into the providers search/filter request.
Make the auth modal switch toggle login/register rather than closing.
Consider preselecting provider role when the landing-page ‘Sou prestador’ CTA is used.
Implement or explicitly scope portfolio/photo authorization, testimonials, ratings, and recommendations; only a POST reviews endpoint exists and no UI is exposed.
Add brute-force lockout if required by the auth playbook; no lockout logic is present.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend fallback providers are demo data and category clicks can show the same unfiltered demo cards when the database is empty; this is MOCKED as specified.
Google OAuth linking is PREPARED/MOCKED and displays a next-step message; it is not an OAuth integration.
Suggested .local test emails in test_credentials.md are rejected by Pydantic EmailStr as reserved domains; use a routable test domain for automated registration tests.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ users and requests through public registration/request flows; no seeded or production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core public UI and API flows passed. Recheck CORS preflight at the public gateway, then verify search filtering and auth modal switching after fixes. Portfolio/reviews UI remains untested/unimplemented.
rca of the issue: Search is disconnected because Home's arrow handler calls search("") without reading the input state. Auth switching closes because AuthModal's switch handler invokes close() and App has no mode-toggle callback. Public OPTIONS CORS differs from backend middleware output, indicating ingress/CDN response rewriting or caching rather than the FastAPI route configuration.
